name: beads-backlog
description: The backlog agent-crew's workers pull from, held in Beads. agent-crew names the moves in the abstract — find existing work, create an item, link a dependency, claim one, close it, record what was learned — and this plugin knows how to make them with `bd`, so a coordinator drives a real store instead of asking which one to use. Swap it for another provider to change store without touching the crew.
